before.name: Red Envelope
before.description: Grants 88,888 runes and a latent power reward for each party member.

after.name: Red Envelope
after.description: Grants 88,888 runes and awards each party member a Dormant Power.

before.name: Celestial Body
before.description: Reduces attack power by 25%. Raises all attributes by 10.

after.name: Celestial Body
after.description: Reduces attack power by 25%. Raises all attributes by 10.

before.name: Glass Cannon
before.description: Increases damage taken tenfold. Boosts attack power by 20%. Damage dealt ignores enemy resistances, defenses, and damage negation.

after.name: Glass Cannon
after.description: Increases damage taken tenfold. Boosts attack power by 20%. Damage dealt ignores enemy defense, resistances, and damage negation, while retaining bonuses from negative resistances.

before.name: Ultimate Revolution
before.description: Fully restores the Art gauge upon using an Ultimate Art. (60-second cooldown.)

after.name: Ultimate Revolution
after.description: Fully restores the Art gauge upon activating an Ultimate Art. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

before.name: Heavy Drinking
before.description: Doubles the number of Flask of Crimson Tears uses, but halves HP restoration. Using a flask boosts attack power by 5% for 15 seconds.

after.name: Heavy Drinking
after.description: Doubles the number of Flask of Crimson Tears uses, but halves the HP restored. Using the flask boosts attack power by 5% for 15 seconds.

before.name: Regeneration
before.description: Continuously consumes FP to restore HP while HP is not at maximum. Using a Flask of Crimson Tears at maximum HP restores 50% of maximum FP.

after.name: Regeneration
after.description: Continuously consumes FP to restore HP while HP is not at maximum. Using a Flask of Crimson Tears at maximum HP restores 50% of maximum FP.

before.name: Crystal Shell
before.description: A crystal shell absorbs an incoming attack and shatters. The shell regenerates after 40 seconds.

after.name: Crystal Shell
after.description: Absorbs damage with a crystal shell that shatters and regenerates after 40 seconds.

before.name: Humans Are Cats
before.description: Allows unlimited climbing. Boosts jump attack damage based on fall height. Silences footsteps. Conceals the body for 1 second upon taking damage.

after.name: Humans Are Cats
after.description: Allows unlimited climbing. Boosts jump attack damage based on fall height. Silences footsteps. Conceals the body for 1 second upon taking damage.

before.name: Draw Your Sword
before.description: Your sorceries and incantations become melee attacks. Their original range is converted into attack power, HP recovery rate, damage negation, and poise. Boosts melee attack power by 15%.

after.name: Draw Your Sword
after.description: Treats sorceries and incantations as melee attacks. Converts their original range into attack power, HP restoration on hit, damage negation, and poise. Boosts melee attack power by 15%.

before.name: Blunt Force
before.description: Boosts the impact of successful attacks.

after.name: Blunt Force
after.description: Boosts the impact of melee attacks.

before.name: Escape Plan
before.description: Increases action speed and boosts damage negation by 60% for 10 seconds when HP is low. (60-second cooldown.)

after.name: Escape Plan
after.description: Increases action speed and boosts damage negation by 60% for 10 seconds when HP is low. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

before.name: Edgelord's Footwork
before.description: Improves backstep evasion. Successful backstep attacks against enemies whose stance is not broken, and critical hits from the front, each fill 25% of the Art gauge. Dodge rolls and damage taken each deplete 30% of the Art gauge. Boosts backstep attack damage by up to 200%, based on the current Art gauge.

after.name: Edgelord's Footwork
after.description: Improves backstep evasion. Landing a backstep attack or frontal critical hit restores 25% of the Art gauge. Rolling or taking damage depletes 30% of the Art gauge. Boosts backstep attack damage based on the Art gauge's current charge.

before.name: Master of Arms
before.description: Reduces skill FP consumption by 100%. Using a skill reforges the skill of that armament.

after.name: Master of Arms
after.description: Reduces FP consumption of weapon skills by 100%. Reforges the armament's skill after each use.

before.name: Poltergeist
before.description: Marking one's own position generates roiling lava. Further marks of one's own position before eruption increase its damage.

after.name: Poltergeist
after.description: Marking the player's own location creates lava that erupts after a brief delay. Repeating this action before the eruption increases its damage.

before.name: Spawner
before.description: Allows evergaols to be opened without a Stonesword Key, releasing a wider variety of enemies. Defeating the prisoners does not create a Site of Grace, but allows the same evergaol to be opened again. Each evergaol can be opened up to five times.

after.name: Spawner
after.description: Allows evergaols to be opened without a Stonesword Key and increases enemy variety. No Site of Grace appears after clearing an evergaol. Each evergaol can be opened up to five times.

before.name: Balloon
before.description: Raises maximum HP by 50%. Reduces damage negation by 30%. Reduces resistance to piercing attacks by 100%. Triggers an explosion upon death or entering near-death, dealing damage equal to maximum HP to nearby enemies.

after.name: Balloon
after.description: Raises maximum HP by 50%. Reduces damage negation by 30%. Reduces resistance to piercing attacks by 100%. Triggers an explosion upon death or entering near-death, dealing damage equal to maximum HP to nearby enemies.

before.name: Enhanced [Necromancy]
before.description: Stores the soul of a powerful enemy defeated by the party, replacing it only with a soul of higher maximum HP. Using [Immortal March] consumes the stored soul to summon a spirit that fights alongside the summoner. The spirit loses 1/60 of its maximum HP each second and deals 25% of its original damage.

after.name: Enhanced [Necromancy]
after.description: Stores the soul of a recently defeated powerful enemy, prioritizing souls with higher maximum HP. Activating [Immortal March] summons its spirit to fight alongside the summoner for a short time.

before.name: Don't Change the Channel
before.description: Restores 30 stamina upon fully charging a sorcery or incantation.

after.name: Don't Change the Channel
after.description: Restores 30 stamina upon fully charging a sorcery or incantation.

before.name: Archmage
before.description: Reduces FP consumption of a catalyst’s secondary spell by 100%. After casting, replaces it with a random new spell.

after.name: Archmage
after.description: Reduces FP consumption of a catalyst's secondary spell by 100%. Casting the spell replaces it with a random new spell.

before.name: Demon's Gaze
before.description: Occasionally creates golden magic circles nearby.

after.name: Demon's Gaze
after.description: Occasionally creates golden magic circles nearby.

before.name: Slingshot
before.description: Extends jumping distance after starting a sprint. Stacks up to three times. Each stack increases jump attack power by 50%.

after.name: Slingshot
after.description: Extends jumping distance after starting a sprint. Stacks up to three times. Each stack boosts jump attack power by 50%.

before.name: Clash
before.description: Attacks grant a guarding effect while two-handing a weapon. After successfully guarding with this effect, guard counters consume no stamina and deal 100% more damage.

after.name: Clash
after.description: Allows attacks made while two-handing an armament to guard against enemy attacks. Guard counters after successfully guarding consume no stamina and deal 100% more damage.

before.name: Night’s Blessing
before.description: Raises attack power by 20% in the Night’s Tide. When HP falls below 20% in the Night’s Tide, gradually restores HP for 15 seconds, then gradually depletes HP until leaving the Night’s Tide. Resets upon touching a site of grace.

after.name: Night's Blessing
after.description: Boosts attack power by 20% in the Night's Tide. When HP is below 20% in the Night's Tide, gradually restores HP for 15 seconds. A backlash then gradually depletes HP until leaving the Night's Tide. Touching a Site of Grace resets this effect.

before.name: Ominous Pact
before.description: Landing attacks causes damage to self equal to 5% of maximum HP. Triggers at most once every 10 seconds.

after.name: Ominous Pact
after.description: Causes self-damage equal to 5% of maximum HP upon landing an attack. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

before.name: Heartstealer
before.description: Landing a charged attack releases a mist of charm. 30-second cooldown.

after.name: Heartstealer
after.description: Releases a mist that charms enemies upon landing a charged attack. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

before.name: Essence Reaver
before.description: Defeating enemies permanently raises maximum FP by 1%.

after.name: Essence Reaver
after.description: Defeating an enemy raises maximum FP by 1% for the rest of the expedition.

before.name: Death’s Dance
before.description: Flasks restore HP gradually. Recoverable damage is taken gradually over 2 seconds. Attacking restores a portion of recently lost HP.

after.name: Death's Dance
after.description: The Flask of Crimson Tears restores HP gradually. Recoverable damage is taken gradually over 2 seconds. Attacks restore a portion of recently lost HP.

before.name: Erosion
before.description: Reduces attack power by 20%. Attacks inflict buildup of the status ailment the target is weakest to.

after.name: Erosion
after.description: Reduces attack power by 20%. Attacks build up the status ailment to which the target is most vulnerable.

before.name: Potential Fission
before.description: Latent powers you obtain next split into two of lower quality. Can trigger 3 times.

after.name: Potential Fission
after.description: Splits each of the next three Dormant Powers obtained into two of lower quality.

before.name: Ambulance
before.description: Sprinting, dashing, and running toward a near-death ally consume no stamina. Restores stamina while continuously rescuing allies.

after.name: Ambulance
after.description: Sprinting, dashing, and running toward a near-death ally consume no stamina. Restores stamina while continuously rescuing allies.

before.name: Echo Casting
before.description: Sorceries and incantations cost 100% more FP and 50% more stamina, and produce an additional projectile after casting.

after.name: Echo Casting
after.description: Increases sorcery and incantation FP consumption by 100% and stamina consumption by 50%. Creates an additional projectile after casting.

before.name: Set Meal
before.description: Shop weapons cost more and come with a stat-boosting latent power when purchased.

after.name: Set Meal
after.description: Increases the price of armaments sold by merchants. Purchasing an armament also grants a Dormant Power with a passive effect.

before.name: Burst of Momentum
before.description: For 10 seconds after landing an attack, boosts attack power by 30% for the first 5 seconds, then reduces attack power and damage negation by 50% for the next 5 seconds.

after.name: Burst of Momentum
after.description: For 10 seconds after landing an attack, boosts attack power by 30% for the first 5 seconds, then reduces attack power and damage negation by 50% for the next 5 seconds.

before.name: Ultimate Awakening
before.description: Eliminates FP consumption for 15 seconds after activating an Ultimate Art.

after.name: Ultimate Awakening
after.description: Eliminates FP consumption for 15 seconds after activating an Ultimate Art.

before.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
before.description: Greatly increases poise and grants immunity to status buildup for 15 seconds after activating an Ultimate Art.

after.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
after.description: Greatly increases poise and grants immunity to status buildup for 15 seconds after activating an Ultimate Art.

before.name: Ultimate Challenge
before.description: Raises maximum HP by 50% and makes you more likely to be targeted by enemies for 15 seconds after activating an Ultimate Art.

after.name: Ultimate Challenge
after.description: Raises maximum HP by 50% and increases the likelihood of being targeted by enemies for 15 seconds after activating an Ultimate Art.

before.name: Enhanced Marking
before.description: Your sliding kick can launch small enemies into the air. Follow-up attacks deal heavy damage to enemies hit by the slide.

after.name: Enhanced [Marking]
after.description: Allows sliding kicks to launch small enemies. Follow-up attacks deal heavy damage to enemies hit by the slide.

before.name: Wraithcaller
before.description: Wraith-calling items consume no FP. After enough successful uses that hit enemies, upgrades to an item that releases more wraiths. Grants a Wraith Calling Bell.

after.name: Wraithcaller
after.description: Eliminates FP consumption for wraith-calling items. Landing enough hits upgrades the item to one that releases more wraiths. Grants a Wraith Calling Bell.

before.name: Back to Basics
before.description: Seals Ultimate Arts. Greatly improves Character Skill cooldown recovery and damage.

after.name: Back to Basics
after.description: Seals Ultimate Arts. Greatly accelerates Character Skill cooldown recovery and boosts its damage.

before.name: Experienced Sniper
before.description: Reduces attack power by 30%. Deal more damage the farther you are from your target. Greatly reduces arrow damage falloff.

after.name: Experienced Sniper
after.description: Reduces attack power by 30%. Boosts damage as the distance to the target increases. Greatly reduces arrow damage falloff with distance.
